changeSet.author: org-svc
changeSet.sql:
create table beneficiary_nodes ( id bigint generated always as identity primary key, organization_id bigint not null, heading varchar(255) not null, image varchar(255), image_side varchar(10) not null default 'left', image_scale integer not null default 100, image_x integer not null default 0, image_y integer not null default 0, text_align varchar(10) not null default 'left', body_html text, position integer not null default 0, active boolean not null default true, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now() );
create index beneficiary_nodes_organization_id_idx on beneficiary_nodes (organization_id);
